summary: End-to-end testing of 4 NEW features (One-Click Campaign, Content Calendar, Landing Page Generator, Export Center) plus nav/dashboard/lang changes. Created /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py (8 tests, all pass) covering /api/generate/campaign, /api/generate/calendar, /api/generate/landingpage, /api/history filter, and DELETE /api/history/{id}. Frontend Playwright verified each module renders real LLM output, image generation works (data:image base64), filters/delete work, hero CTA navigates to /campaign, dashboard shows 9 module cards, sidebar has all nav items. No critical issues found.

minor.issue: Always returns 200 {ok:true} even when the id does not exist. Idempotent but a 404 would be more REST-correct. Non-blocking.
Uses sync requests.get for logo fetch inside async event loop (when apply_logo=true). Same observation as iteration 1 — consider httpx.AsyncClient.

issues: Posts list shows hashtags with #-prefix in chips; consistent. No issue.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Return 404 from DELETE /api/history/{id} when the item does not exist.
OPTIONAL (carried over): swap requests.get for httpx.AsyncClient in _fetch_logo_b64.

INFO: The review-request mentioned testids 'hero-cta', 'lang-en/de', 'dashboard-module-*'; actual implementation uses 'hero-start-social', 'lang-EN/DE', 'module-card-*'. Functionality correct; consider aligning testid naming if downstream tests depend on the spec'd names.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~640 lines — still manageable but the generation endpoints could be split into a dedicated router for maintainability.
All new endpoints correctly exclude MongoDB '_id' from responses via record.pop('_id', None) after insert.
asyncio.gather with return_exceptions=True in /api/generate/campaign is correct — partial failures (e.g. image gen) degrade gracefully (image=None) instead of failing the whole campaign.
_extract_json fallback handles fenced JSON well. The 'days' validator silently coerces invalid input to 30 — could surface as 422 for better client feedback, but acceptable.
Frontend pages all use process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL via AppContext (no hardcoded URLs).
All interactive elements on new pages have data-testid attributes — testability is good.

Landingpage buildHtml inlines all CSS in a template literal — fine for the export use case; XSS risk is low because content is LLM-generated for the user's own download, but if the export were ever shared via URL, server-side sanitisation would be advisable.
seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_-prefixed history entries (campaign, calendar, landingpage, copy). All identifiable items can be cleaned via DELETE /api/history/{id} or by filtering the Export Center. Test_delete_history_item self-cleans its created item.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 9 routes implemented: /, /campaign, /brand, /social, /image, /copy, /landing, /calendar, /prompts, /export. Backend tests: backend_test.py (original CRUD/social/copy/image) + test_new_features.py (campaign/calendar/landingpage/history filter+delete). Campaign endpoint takes ~50-90s due to asyncio.gather of text+text+image; allow 240s timeout in UI tests. Image rendering verified as data:image base64 strings. testid prefixes confirmed: module-card-{slug}, hero-start-social, lang-EN/DE, nav-{slug}, campaign-{topic-input|platform-X|style-X|logo-switch|generate-btn|result|image|image-download|copy-copy|post-copy-X}, calendar-{topic-input|days-30/60/90|platform-X|generate-btn|result|item-i|export-txt}, landing-{topic-input|generate-btn|result|export-html}, export-{filter-X|item-id|txt-id|json-id|png-id|delete-id}.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs requiring RCA. The earlier Playwright timeout on campaign generation was caused by a 180s wait_for_selector hitting just before the LLM response arrived; re-running with 240s succeeded and confirmed full E2E.
